The removal date has already passed, so image generation requests now fail. The fix is to switch to the gpt-image-2 family (or gpt-image-2.5). Note that gpt-image models do not support response_format='url' the way DALL·E did; they return b64_json. The migration agent should therefore check the response_format field and how the response data is read, and confirm where the model id is set in the payload or client config.
guixincui/LobeChat:openai:2026-04-22-legacy-gpt-oct-retirement: The repo predates gpt-4o, and its default and selectable chat models are the gpt-3.5-turbo and gpt-4 families listed in this shutdown, which took effect on 2026-10-23. Chat, the app's core feature, now returns model-not-found errors for any session using these defaults. The migration agent should find the default model constant and model list (likely in src/const or the settings and agent config), replace them with gpt-5.6 models, and add a migration for persisted session and agent configs. Uncertain: the exact model ids hardcoded in the frontend catalog are not in the usage map and should be verified.
guixincui/LobeChat:openai:2025-09-26-legacy-gpt-sep-2026: gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 was released alongside this SDK version, and LobeChat of that period listed it as a selectable chat model. guixincui/LobeChat:openai:2026-10-01-tts-retirement: OpenAI TTS goes through @lobehub/tts, which uses tts-1 as its default and options model. After 2027-01-06, text-to-speech playback with the OpenAI voice will fail. The migration agent should check which model id the client or @lobehub/tts sends. It should then either update @lobehub/tts to a version supporting gpt-realtime-2.1-mini or override the model, noting that the replacement may require a different API surface than /v1/audio/speech.
guixincui/LobeChat:openai:2026-08-26-transcription-retirement: Speech-to-text uses OpenAI transcriptions through @lobehub/tts, and its default model is whisper-1. After 2027-02-26, voice input will fail. The migration agent should switch the model to gpt-transcribe, either via a payload or options override or a @lobehub/tts upgrade, and verify that the response shape (text) is unchanged.
